about: The falsifier: every act read every reader's observation back, offer by offer, though nothing it reads had moved. After B39 on the tree at epoch 266, with 0 readers run: `OBSERVE 0 run · 2822 read by key · 14958 ms` — 39 shard files of 8.3 MB, the observations by key and the lock, read from the external disk on every pass, check and accept; 12 to 26 s of every line-only lot.

cases.name: observation on the tree after B39, nothing moved
